_readme: Assumptions used by the tool. Edit freely. Material rules are tried top-down; 'match' is a case-insensitive regular expression on the IFC material name. 'lambda' is the design thermal conductivity [W/mK]; air layers use a fixed thermal resistance 'R' [m2K/W]. 'table7_id' is the 'Sorterings ID' in BR18 Table 7 (input/Tabel-7-2025.xlsx). Lambda values are typical design values and should be checked against the product data.
_u_value_requirement_note: BR18 component requirement for exterior walls in new buildings (Bilag 2, tabel 1). For renovation of exterior walls BR18 Bilag 2, tabel 2 states 0.18. Verify for your project.

materials._note: Unventilated air layer >= 25 mm, ISO 6946 table 8
Revit layer 'Structure, Wood Joist/Rafter Layer, Batt Insulation' treated as mineral wool batts kl. 37 - timber studs are not included
Gipsplade, standard - Table 7 unit is m2 (one board), so thickness is not scaled
Thin metal finish/furring: GWP not calculated (layer volume is not steel volume)
